title: Munich Waste Sorting
subtitle: Where does it go? A game for everyone new to Munich.
how_1: An object falls. Slide the belt until the right container is under the frame.
how_2: Tap the object to take a closer look or to take it apart.
how_3: Tap anywhere else to drop it at once. Early and right scores more, early and wrong costs more.
how_keys: Keyboard: ← → belt · Tab or 1–5 place · ↑ look · Space drop
examine_note: Looking costs a little time but gives nothing away.
tier_intro_first: You are at home. These are your bins.
tier_intro_more: Everything you already know stays on the belt.
need_share: You need {share}%. Mistakes never block you – try again.
empty_tier_line: There are no objects for this place yet.
undivided: It can't go whole – take it apart first: {parts}
fixture_banner: Test build: content not yet checked by a person. When in doubt, awm-muenchen.de is right
finale_strip: Strip it first: tap everything that is not part of the tree.
finale_stripped: Bare, and free of plastic. Where does the tree go now?
finale_edition: Dates for the {season} season according to the City of Munich. Next season's dates are not out yet – check awm-muenchen.de/christbaum.
share_text: I scored {points} points at Munich Waste Sorting. Do you know where the drinks carton goes?
source_note: Every rule comes from Munich's waste authority (AWM). When in doubt, awm-muenchen.de is right.
unverified: ✎ Not yet reviewed by a person
touch_hint: Swipe: belt · Tap the object: look or take apart · Tap elsewhere: drop
